definitions.gloss: very rich person; wealthy individual; millionaire
definitions.explanation: An intensified form of 金持ち (rich person), emphasizing extreme wealth. Colloquial and commonly used in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {大金持|おおがねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become very rich.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大金持|おおがねも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{別荘|べっそう}→別荘：11786_bessou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{何軒|なんけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: That person is extremely wealthy and owns several vacation homes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たったら→当たる：01860_ataru⟧{大金持|おおがねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: If only I won the lottery, I could become very rich.

notes:
A compound of {大|おお} (great/big) + ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ (rich person). The prefix {大|おお} intensifies the base word, indicating extreme wealth rather than mere comfort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大金持|おおがねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become very rich
- {大金持|おおがねも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a wealthy person's house
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大金持|おおがねも}ち: the world's richest people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧: rich person — the standard term; less emphatic
- ⟦{富豪|ふごう}→富豪：20556_fugou⟧: wealthy person, tycoon — formal; used in news and writing
- {大富豪|だいふごう}: extremely wealthy person — formal version of {大金持|おおがねも}ち
- ⟦{資産家|しさんか}→資産家：16291_shisanka⟧: person of means — formal; focuses on assets rather than income
